messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.7

4.1.2.7. Movements of loads during handling The operating position of machinery must be located in such a way as to ensure the widest possible view of trajectories of the moving parts, in order to avoid possible collisions with persons, equipment or other machinery which might be manoeuvring at the same time and liable to constitute a hazard. Machinery with guided loads must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons from being injured by movement of the load, the carrier or the counterweights, if any.

response.text:
Machinery operating position | must be located | in such a way as to ensure the widest possible view of trajectories of the moving parts | | The operating position of machinery must be located in such a way as to ensure the widest possible view of trajectories of the moving parts
Machinery operating position | purpose of view | avoiding possible collisions with persons, equipment or other machinery | where other machinery or equipment is manoeuvring at the same time and is liable to constitute a hazard | in order to avoid possible collisions with persons, equipment or other machinery which might be manoeuvring at the same time and liable to constitute a hazard
Machinery with guided loads | must be designed and constructed | to prevent persons from being injured by movement of the load, the carrier or the counterweights | | Machinery with guided loads must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons from being injured by movement of the load, the carrier or the counterweights
Movement of the load | can injure | persons | where the machinery has guided loads and no protective design is provided | Machinery with guided loads must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent persons from being injured by movement of the load
Movement of the carrier | can injure | persons | where the machinery has guided loads and no protective design is provided | prevent persons from being injured by movement of the load, the carrier or the counterweights
Counterweights | must not injure | persons | if any are fitted | prevent persons from being injured by movement of the load, the carrier or the counterweights, if any
